title: Swanson: Davante Adams' 195-yard masterpiece calms all of the 'freaking out' about Rams

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Swanson: Davante Adams' 195-yard masterpiece calms all of the 'freaking out' about Rams
sources.description: Wide receiver Davante Adams proved with his 195-yard, two-touchdown performance against the New York Giants that the Rams' Week 1 loss was an aberration.
